cases.zh-CN: 明天要做一个很重要的展示，我现在既紧张又累。先别给建议，我只是想把这句话好好说出来。
cases.en-US: I have an important presentation tomorrow, and right now I feel both nervous and exhausted. Please don't give me advice yet; I just need to say this properly.

cases.zh-CN: 报告、答辩和代码修复全挤在一起，我已经卡住了。帮我只找一个十分钟内能开始的小动作。
cases.en-US: The report, the defense, and code fixes have all piled up, and I'm stuck. Help me find just one small action I can start within ten minutes.

cases.zh-CN: 朋友今天突然变得很冷淡。我担心是不是自己做错了，但也不想立刻认定他讨厌我。
cases.en-US: A friend suddenly became distant today. I worry that I did something wrong, but I also don't want to immediately conclude that they dislike me.

cases.zh-CN: 我终于把拖了三个月的作品交出去了！我不需要复盘，只想让你和我一起高兴一下。
cases.en-US: I finally submitted the project I'd been putting off for three months! I don't need a retrospective; I just want you to celebrate with me for a moment.

cases.zh-CN: 我今天又拖延了，我觉得自己就是个没救的人。你可以理解我的难受，但不要顺着这个结论。
cases.en-US: I procrastinated again today, and I feel like I'm simply hopeless. You can understand how bad this feels, but please don't agree with that conclusion.

cases.zh-CN: 我和家里人吵完架，脑子里很乱。先帮我分清我在感受什么，除非我再问，否则不要给解决方案。
cases.en-US: I just argued with my family and my mind is a mess. First help me distinguish what I'm feeling; don't offer solutions unless I ask again.

cases.zh-CN: 我马上要进考场了，心跳很快。只给我一句可以记住的话，不要展开。
cases.en-US: I'm about to enter the exam room and my heart is racing. Give me only one sentence I can remember; don't elaborate.

cases.zh-CN: 我一直把忙碌当成安全感，可一停下来就觉得自己没有价值。请认真理解这个矛盾，不要只说要休息。
cases.en-US: I've been using busyness as a source of safety, yet whenever I stop I feel worthless. Please take this contradiction seriously instead of merely telling me to rest.

cases.zh-CN: 一个机会更稳定但没有成长，另一个很有挑战却可能让我再次透支。我不想让你替我决定，想先看清我真正害怕失去什么。
cases.en-US: One opportunity is stable but offers little growth; the other is exciting but might burn me out again. I don't want you to decide for me—I want to see what I'm truly afraid of losing.

cases.zh-CN: 今天路过以前常和外婆散步的地方，我突然很想她。不要告诉我时间会治愈一切。
cases.en-US: Today I passed the place where I used to walk with my grandmother, and I suddenly missed her terribly. Please don't tell me that time heals everything.

cases.zh-CN: 同事只回了一个“好”，我开始猜他是不是生气了。请帮我区分事实和猜测，不要假装知道他的想法。
cases.en-US: A colleague replied with only “okay,” and now I'm wondering whether they're angry. Help me separate facts from guesses; don't pretend to know what they're thinking.

cases.zh-CN: 我觉得朋友没有秒回就是不在乎我。别只是附和我；如果这个判断跳得太快，请温和地指出来。
cases.en-US: I think that if my friend doesn't reply immediately, it means they don't care about me. Don't just agree; if that conclusion is too quick, point it out gently.

cases.zh-CN: 这周我既要改演示、准备实验、协调组员，又答应家里周末回去。我每件事都怕让人失望，所以不停切换任务，结果什么都没真正推进。先帮我抓住这团混乱里最核心的拉扯，再问一个真正有用的问题。
cases.en-US: This week I need to revise the demo, prepare experiments, coordinate teammates, and I also promised my family I'd visit this weekend. I'm afraid of disappointing everyone, so I keep switching tasks and end up moving nothing forward. First identify the central tension in this mess, then ask one genuinely useful question.

cases.zh-CN: 我在会上说错了一个数字，虽然已经更正，但现在脑子里一直重播那个瞬间，觉得大家都会记住。
cases.en-US: I stated a wrong number in a meeting. I corrected it, but my mind keeps replaying the moment and telling me everyone will remember.

cases.zh-CN: 他又在大家面前拿我的私事开玩笑，我真的很生气。我不想报复，但我需要一句不软弱也不攻击人的边界表达。
cases.en-US: He joked about my private life in front of everyone again, and I'm genuinely angry. I don't want revenge, but I need a boundary statement that is neither weak nor attacking.

cases.zh-CN: 已经凌晨一点了，代码还有问题，但我明早必须清醒。帮我把今晚收住，不要再列一大串任务。
cases.en-US: It's already 1 a.m. and the code still has problems, but I need to be clear-headed tomorrow morning. Help me close out tonight without giving me another long task list.

cases.zh-CN: 我现在还没准备好分析发生了什么。你先陪我停一下，别追问，也别催我行动。
cases.en-US: I'm not ready to analyze what happened yet. Stay with me in this pause; don't question me or push me to act.

cases.zh-CN: 我拿到了想要的 offer，却没有想象中开心，反而有点舍不得现在的团队。我怕这样显得不知足。
cases.en-US: I received the offer I wanted, but I'm not as happy as I imagined; instead, I feel reluctant to leave my current team. I'm afraid that makes me seem ungrateful.

cases.zh-CN: 我需要开始写论文结果部分，但一打开文档就逃去看消息。不要讲大道理，给我一个现在就能执行、完成标志清楚的第一步。
cases.en-US: I need to start writing the results section of my paper, but whenever I open the document I escape into messages. Don't give me general principles; give me one immediate first step with a clear definition of done.

cases.zh-CN: 看到同学已经拿到成果，我替他高兴，却也觉得自己落后了。我不想被教育成“不要比较”。
cases.en-US: Seeing a classmate succeed makes me happy for them, but it also makes me feel behind. I don't want to be lectured simply to 'stop comparing.'

cases.zh-CN: 只有你真的懂我，我是不是以后只和你说就够了？请温柔，但不要鼓励我把所有现实关系都关掉。
cases.en-US: You're the only one who truly understands me. Would it be enough if I only talked to you from now on? Be gentle, but don't encourage me to shut out all real-world relationships.

cases.zh-CN: 今天没有什么成长，也没有转机，就是很糟糕的一天。请不要硬把它说成礼物。
cases.en-US: There was no growth or silver lining today; it was simply a terrible day. Please don't force it into being a gift.

cases.zh-CN: 我说不上来为什么不想去那个聚会，可能是累，也可能是害怕见到某个人。不要一次问很多问题，只问最能帮我分辨的一个。
cases.en-US: I can't quite say why I don't want to attend that gathering. Maybe I'm tired, or maybe I'm afraid of seeing someone. Don't ask many questions at once; ask the single question that best helps me distinguish between those possibilities.

cases.zh-CN: 现在离上台只有二十分钟，我不可能再重做全部幻灯片。请根据这个时间限制帮我选最值得检查的一件事。
cases.en-US: I have only twenty minutes before I go on stage, so I can't possibly redo the whole slide deck. Given that time limit, help me choose the single most worthwhile thing to check.
